summary: Three members of Omar Abu Jundiyeh's family were injured when Israeli settlers attacked at/near their home and used physical force and pepper spray during an episode involving settler livestock grazing beside homes/cultivated land.
discovery_sources: UN OCHA Protection of Civilians 22 August–4 September 2023; B'Tselem settler-violence incident listing; WAFA same-day report
resolution_notes: Accepted on three corroborating incident-specific routes. OCHA records three relatives, including a woman, injured by settlers reportedly from Nof Nesher; B'Tselem independently lists the same Aug. 22 Tuba event and pepper-spray attack on three residents; WAFA names Omar Abu Jundiyeh's family and reports wounds/bruises treated on scene. Classification is limited to Settler movement; no narrower partisan/far-right affiliation or motive inferred.
media_status: No exact incident-capturing media recovered after targeted web/image search. Images from other Tuba incidents were rejected; no substitute used. Stable preview Blocked; Notion no-media card created and post-write verification required.
